id.description: The unique and required id of this instance.

acl.description: List of {@link AclEntry} entries governing who can read/update/remove Objs.

version.description:
Version number used for optimistic concurrency.  Automatically managed by the system.

Updating an Obj with a null or 0 value for version will cause the concurrency check to be skipped and should only
be done with great caution.

typeWithBindings.description: Persists concrete type with bindings for generic types where instance has parameter bindings

sessionType.description: The concrete type of the session being saved.

setupSpec.description: The state used to initialize the session.

touched.description: The last time this session was accessed by the user.

globals.description:
A map of serializations of global variables in the session at the time it was saved. This map is produced by
ImplLanguage.Session#saveGlobals and consumed by {@link ImplLanguage.Session#loadGlobals loadGlobals} so the
session can also the most natural data representation.

This will be incomplete if the session state contains things we don't know how to serialize.

name: ImplLanguage.SavedSession
